Subject: MAP: Launchpad — GRC & evidence owners for evaluation

Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood for the HelixDocs search-and-assist pilot. To keep the evaluation tight and unblock procurement, we'd like to spin up a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the security and evidence handoff we discussed.

Attached: MAP_Launchpad_v1.0.xlsx (simple timeline + owner columns).

Quick ask from our side so we can finalize the MAP by EOD Monday:
- Can you confirm a single GRC point of contact for SOC 2 / audit questions?
- Who owns evidence collection (system screenshots, controls narratives)?
- Who should we loop in for any data handling / data flow questions (PII, retention)?

Proposed short timeline (can adjust):
1) This week: agree MAP owners + schedule 45m SOC2/evidence sync
2) Week of 2/15: evidence collection + reviewer calls
3) Week of 2/22: final readout and procurement-friendly summary

Laura and Neha are on the thread — Neha leads our SOC 2 intake and will coordinate evidence requests. Laura will help on timelines and the procurement checklist.

Would Thursday 2/12 at 11am PT work for a 45m sync? If not, suggest two alternate times.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Markus Klein
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Markus — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the clear MAP starter. Short answers below and a couple of attachments that should help: Helix_Soc2_readout_2025.pdf (summary) and a network/dataflow diagram link.

GRC lead: Aaron Li <aaron.li@helixdocs.com> — he owns incoming audit responses and vendor attestations.
Evidence owner: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixdocs.com> — Priya consolidates screenshots, configs, and control narratives.
Data handling / retention contact: Elena Morales (me) — I run product security and data classification for HelixDocs; Priya will feed me any specific ingestion questions.

On timing: 2/12 at 11am PT works for us. Aaron and Priya can join.

Two quick notes:
- We have an internal SOC 2 readout from late 2025 that may answer a lot of config questions — attaching a one-pager.
- Can you share a minimal evidence checklist (types of artifacts + suggested owners) so Priya can pre-gather items?

See you Thursday.

Best,
